title: Courtesy Permit Fee Computation under the Student Transportation Services Fee Schedule, 2026-27
content:
**Definition.** A Student Transportation Services courtesy permit fee is the period rate times the billed share of the permit period, rounded half-up to the cent once on the result. The period rate is the permit fee of the type in the fee table. The billed share is the calendar days from the posting day to the last day of the permit period, divided by the calendar days from the period's first school day to its last day. The posting day is the application date, or the signing day for a seat offered from the waiting list.

## Figures of the permit period

| Permit | First school day | Last day | Months |
|---|---|---|---|
| school-year permit, Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | August 12, 2026 | May 31, 2027 | 10 |
| fall semester permit, Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | August 12, 2026 | December 31, 2026 | 5 |
| spring semester permit, Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | January 6, 2027 | May 31, 2027 | 5 |

From the first school day to the last day the periods run 292 calendar days (school year), 141 (fall semester) and 145 (spring semester). A count of calendar days from one date to another is the number of days by which the later date follows the earlier.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A school-year permit whose period rate is taken as 200.00 USD for the illustration, with a posting day of October 15:

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| calendar days from October 15 to May 31 | 228 |
| billed share | 228 divided by 292: 0.780822 |
| period rate times the billed share | 156.1644 |
| rounded half-up to the cent | 156.16 USD |

A fall semester permit with a period rate taken as 100.00 USD and a posting day of November 1: 60 days divided by 141, 0.425532, gives 42.55 USD.
